senses.gloss: m. (מָסַס) [the dissolving (digesting) receptacle,] the first stomach of ruminants, cmp. הַבְלִילָא.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 3:1">Ḥull. III, 1</cite> <cite ref="E00636"><he>המסס</he></cite> (= <he>הַהֶ׳</he>, or <cite ref="E00636"><he>הַמָּסָס</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 4:4">Lev. R. s. 4</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 103:1">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIII</cite>, beg. <he>המ׳ לטחון</he> the first stomach has the function of grinding (the food).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 18:1">Lev. R. s. 18</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:3:1">Koh. R. to XII, 3</cite> ‘the grinders’ (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 12:3:1">ib.</cite>) <he>זו ה׳</he> that is the stomach. [From later usage, e.g. Tur Yoré Deah 49, and from its Chald. equivalent it would seem that our w. is <cite ref="E00636"><he>הֶמְסֵס</he></cite>, and the definite article fused with the <cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite> of the noun.]
